text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the outdoor stage one<n>day, I spot
Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I figured no one would be using the<n>place at this
time of day, but I guess I<n>was wrong. What's with
the<n>mountain of boxes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They're filled with new yoga mats<n>and stuff... Huh,
good quality, too.<n>Why are they all wrapped up,
though?<n>These prizes for something?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Taishin! You here to help<n>pack up, too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're cleaning up the stage after the<n>event the
other day. Y'know, like<n>packing up the set and
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez and the others needed some<n>extra hands, so
that's why we're<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We get to keep any leftover prizes<n>once we're
done! It's treasure<n>huntin' time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Count me in. I'll help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decide to pitch in, and<n>everyone starts
taking down the set.<n>We seem to be making pretty
good<n>headway, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew. There's no end to this! How<n>many more
boxes do I have to lug<n>around?! No one told me it'd
be this<n>much work!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I underestimated how long this would<n>take... Why'd
they even build such a<n>massive set?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! Comin' through! Outta the<n>way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hey, look ou—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... We're finally done.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Sure, we kinda banged things up a bit,<n>but we still
got the job done!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You said it. Anyway, I'm gonna take<n>this yoga mat
and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Actually... Sorry to burst your bubble,<n>but we're not
done yet. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but there's still more stuff<n>backstage! I really
wanted to help<n>Prez out as much as possible, so I
told her we'd take care of it all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you for real? I'm already<n>exhausted as is.
choice_data_list: I'll help out until it's all done.
Let's find an efficient way to do this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Damn it. Let's just get thisover with.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Pant... Turbo... boo...oost...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're gonna boost<n>yourself flat on
your face. No clue<n>how to conserve your energy,
huh?<n>Go rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Urgh... O-okay. I'll just take a teeny<n>break!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teio, be more careful when<n>dismantling the set.
Unless you want<n>it to fall apart and crush you. Your
funeral.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you've got a point. Thanks,<n>Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... If this isn't the definition of<n>hard labor, I
dunno what is.
choice_data_list: Yet you're still here helping out.
Yet you're still here helping out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing this out of the kindness<n>of my heart.
I'm only here for the<n>reward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Enough talk. Get to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes a while, but Narita Taishin<n>manages to finish
tidying everything<n>up and gets her well-earned
reward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You can only be so efficient. Do you<n>realize how
long it took just to get<n>this spot done?
choice_data_list: Just think of it as a video game quest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue the game metaphor and tell<n>her to decide
where to position her<n>party members.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. A quest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I guess you'd be an engineer, Teio,<n>since you're
dexterous. You handle<n>the delicate work, like
dismantling the<n>set and storing any hardware.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As for Turbo... You're agile, so kind of<n>like a foot
soldier, I guess. I want you<n>to focus on carrying
things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You're a villager.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And as a villager, you get the fun task<n>of doing all
of the menial odd jobs.<n>Now get to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We manage to get the job done by<n>following Narita
Taishin's instructions,<n>and she receives her
well-earned<n>yoga mat.
